mainEntity.name: When does the final quality walkthrough typically occur?

acceptedAnswer.text: The final quality walkthrough typically occurs once all construction work is substantially complete, usually a few days to a week before the official project handover. It's scheduled when only minor finishing touches or punch list items remain. For Frasheski Construction, we aim to schedule this at a point where the client can clearly visualize the completed project and provide feedback on any final details before occupancy.
